job.job_description:
We are looking for a Senior Generative AI Engineer with strong hands-on experience in AI/ML and LLM technologies. The role requires excellent communication, leadership skills, and deep coding expertise to build and deploy enterprise Gen AI solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop Generative AI and LLM-based solutions
Implement RAG pipelines, AI agents, prompt engineering, and knowledge systems
Integrate Gen AI models with enterprise applications and workflows
Lead technical design and mentor junior team members
Work with stakeholders to identify and implement AI use cases
Ensure scalability, security, and performance of AI solutions

Mandatory Skills

Technical:

Strong coding in Python (mandatory)
Experience with LLMs, NLP, Gen AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Hugging Face)
Experience with ML frameworks (PyTorch / TensorFlow)
Knowledge of Vector Databases (Pinecone, FAISS, Weaviate, Chroma)
Cloud experience (Azure / AWS / GCP)
API development and integration experience

Soft Skills:

Excellent communication skills
Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities

Preferred Skills:

Experience with enterprise AI deployments
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines
Experience in data engineering or ML pipelines
